Unique Curtains & Apparels is a growing business specialising in curtains, home furnishings, textiles, and apparel products. We are seeking a motivated and experienced Accountant to join our team and support the financial management and growth of our business.
Key Responsibilities
•	Preparing financial statements, management reports, and budgets.
•	Maintaining accounting records and ensuring compliance with accounting standards and relevant legislation.
•	Preparing and lodging BAS, payroll tax, and other statutory reporting requirements.
•	Monitoring cash flow, accounts payable, and accounts receivable.
•	Conducting financial analysis and providing recommendations to improve business performance.
•	Assisting with budget preparation, forecasting, and financial planning.
•	Reconciling bank accounts and general ledger accounts.
•	Coordinating with external accountants, auditors, and regulatory authorities.
•	Ensuring compliance with taxation obligations and company policies.
•	Assisting management with strategic financial decision-making.
Qualifications:
•	Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
•	At least 1 year of relevant post-qualification experience as an Accountant, or a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience where no formal qualification is held.
•	Strong knowledge of Australian accounting principles, taxation requirements, and financial reporting.
•	Proficiency in accounting software such as Xero, MYOB or similar systems.
•	Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Why Join Us?
•	Competitive salary and benefits package.
•	Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
•	Be part of a supportive and inclusive team environment.
•	Work for a company that values sustainability and ethical business practices.
How to Apply:
Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter outlining their qualifications and why they are a good fit for the role to email: uniquecurtainsacc@gmail.com.

Applications deadline: 4 weeks after posting date
We look forward to finding our next great team member!

Detailed Duties and Responsibilities:
•	Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, CSM, HRSD, App Engine Studio, and custom applications.
•	Define scalable, secure, and maintainable solution architectures aligned with business and technical requirements.
•	Design and implement integrations using REST APIs with enterprise applications, ensuring secure authentication, error handling, and monitoring.
•	Architect workflow automation using Flow Designer, App Engine Studio, Service Catalog, Record Producers, and Order Guides.
•	Lead ServiceNow platform upgrades, release planning, risk assessment, deployment strategy, and post-upgrade validation.
•	Design and implement Automated Test Framework (ATF) strategies to improve release quality, regression testing, and platform stability.
•	Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, code reviews, governance, and enforcement of ServiceNow best practices.
•	Develop and oversee platform customizations including Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, Scheduled Jobs, Workspaces, and Database Views.
•	Manage platform security, CMDB governance, domain separation, data integrity, reporting, dashboards, and enterprise platform health.
•	Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, development teams, QA, and executive leadership to deliver AI-enabled ServiceNow solutions and provide strategic technical guidance.

Required Qualifications:
•	Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
•	ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) certification (mandatory).
•	ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications preferred.
•	ServiceNow Micro-Certifications in Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Virtual Agent, or App Engine are desirable.

Required Experience:
•	Approximately 10–12 years of experience implementing and architecting ServiceNow solutions within enterprise environments.
•	Extensive experience across ITSM, CSM, HRSD, Service Catalog, CMDB, App Engine Studio, Flow Designer, and platform customization.
•	Proven experience designing enterprise integrations using REST APIs and IntegrationHub.
•	Hands-on experience leading ServiceNow upgrades, platform governance, domain-separated implementations, and enterprise migrations.
•	Experience implementing Automated Test Framework (ATF) and enterprise testing strategies.
•	Experience engaging with senior business stakeholders and leading discovery workshops, solution design, and technical governance.
•	Exposure to Generative AI and Agentic AI capabilities within the ServiceNow ecosystem is highly desirable.

Required Skills and Competencies:
•	Expert knowledge of ServiceNow platform architecture and solution design.
•	Strong expertise in JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and Service Portal/Workspaces.
•	Deep understanding of Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, App Engine Studio, CMDB, Discovery, and ServiceNow security architecture.
•	Experience designing scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise ServiceNow solutions.
•	Strong knowledge of REST APIs, authentication mechanisms, integration patterns, and automation frameworks.
•	Excellent problem-solving, stakeholder management, presentation, and communication skills with the ability to engage CXO-level audiences.
•	Strong leadership, mentoring, architectural governance, and decision-making capabilities.
•	Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused solutions while driving AI-first digital transformation initiatives.

Job Summary
Ausgreen Solar Solutions is a renewable energy solutions provider operating across New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory, specialising in the supply of solar panels, inverters, batteries, and energy efficiency products for residential, commercial, and industrial customers. The business provides tailored renewable energy solutions, technical product advice, and professional support to assist customers in adopting sustainable energy systems.
We are currently seeking a motivated and experienced Marketing Specialist to join our team on a full-time basis. This role is ideal for a creative and analytical marketing professional who enjoys developing marketing strategies, conducting market research, managing promotional activities, and supporting business growth within a growing renewable energy industry.

Why You'll Love This Role
• Salary: $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation

What We're Looking For

K8 Building Tech Pty Ltd offers market-leading solutions and products for the commercial and residential construction sectors, specialising in thermal, acoustic and fire-rated building systems. Working with leading manufacturers and suppliers, we deliver high-quality building solutions for projects ranging from single residential dwellings to Tier 1 commercial developments.

Due to continued business growth, K8 Building Tech Pty Ltd is seeking a dedicated full-time Procurement Specialist to enhance procurement effectiveness across the business. The role will provide strategic advice to management on sourcing strategies, supplier performance, procurement processes, inventory optimisation and continuous improvement initiatives. This position is based at our head office in Port Melbourne, Victoria.

Base salary: $79,423 (plus super)

Main tasks include:
•	Analyse procurement requirements, demand forecasts and inventory information to develop sourcing strategies and purchasing plans that support business objectives.
•	Source, assess and recommend suppliers by evaluating pricing, product quality, lead times, service capability and overall commercial value.
•	Manage supplier relationships and support commercial negotiations relating to pricing, supply arrangements and procurement terms.
•	Monitor supplier performance, procurement expenditure and purchasing trends to identify cost-saving opportunities, manage supply risks and improve procurement outcomes.
•	Prepare procurement reports and provide insights and recommendations to management regarding procurement performance, supplier management and inventory optimisation.
•	Develop, implement and maintain procurement policies, procedures, documentation and governance frameworks to support consistent and compliant procurement practices.
•	Support the optimisation and ongoing use of MYOB Acumatica ERP to improve procurement processes, inventory visibility and business reporting capabilities.
•	Analyse procurement processes and performance indicators to identify improvement opportunities, enhance efficiency and strengthen supply chain outcomes.
•	Work collaboratively with sales, warehouse and management teams to align procurement strategies with customer demand, inventory requirements and operational priorities.
•	Support contract administration activities by maintaining supplier agreements, commercial documentation and procurement records.
Required Qualifications and Experience:
•	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Commerce, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Logistics, Operations Management or a related discipline.
•	Minimum 2–3 years’ experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, supply chain management or commercial procurement.
•	Experience within construction materials, building products, manufacturing or wholesale distribution industries is highly regarded.

Ideal Skills and Attributes:
•	Knowledge of ERP systems such as MYOB Acumatica, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics 365.
•	Strong analytical and commercial acumen.
•	Contract administration and negotiation skills.
•	Excellent stakeholder engagement, communication and organisational skills.

Fleet Manager
Business: Pacific Automotive Holdings Pty Ltd T/A SIXT Car Rental
Location:  Caringbah NSW 2229
Employment Type: Full-time, Ongoing
Salary: AUD $80,000 – $90,000 per annum plus superannuation
 
Full Job Description
About the Business
Pacific Automotive Holdings Pty Ltd, trading as SIXT Car Rental, is a leading vehicle rental business operating from Caringbah, New South Wales. As part of the internationally recognised SIXT network, the business provides short-term and long-term vehicle rental solutions to private individuals, corporate clients, government organisations, and insurance customers. The branch manages a diverse fleet of passenger vehicles, SUVs, commercial vehicles, and specialty vehicles while delivering high standards of customer service, operational efficiency, and vehicle availability.
Operating within the highly competitive vehicle rental industry, the business coordinates vehicle acquisitions, fleet utilisation, maintenance scheduling, customer bookings, vehicle leasing, logistics, and asset management. Maintaining an efficient and well-managed fleet is critical to ensuring customer satisfaction, maximising vehicle utilisation, controlling operational costs, and supporting the continued growth of the business.
Due to increasing customer demand and ongoing fleet expansion, Pacific Automotive Holdings Pty Ltd is seeking to appoint a dedicated Fleet Manager to oversee the day-to-day management of its vehicle fleet and rental operations.

About the Role
The Fleet Manager is responsible for organising and controlling the buying, leasing, maintenance, utilisation, and operational management of the company's rental vehicle fleet. The role involves coordinating vehicle availability, customer bookings, fleet maintenance, supplier relationships, operational reporting, regulatory compliance, and customer service to ensure efficient business operations.
The successful applicant will possess strong organisational, leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills together with the ability to manage multiple operational priorities within a busy vehicle rental environment.

Key Responsibilities
The successful applicant will be responsible for:
•	Organising and coordinating the purchase, leasing, disposal, maintenance, and utilisation of rental vehicles to ensure optimal fleet performance.
•	Planning and coordinating vehicle servicing, repairs, inspections, registrations, and maintenance schedules to maximise vehicle availability.
•	Liaising with customers to determine vehicle rental requirements, provide advice regarding suitable vehicle types, rental rates, insurance obligations, and resolving customer enquiries and complaints.
•	Receiving vehicle bookings and coordinating vehicle allocation to ensure efficient utilisation of fleet resources.
•	Arranging vehicle collection, delivery, transfers, and logistics between customers, branches, workshops, and service providers.
•	Monitoring fleet availability, utilisation rates, maintenance costs, fuel usage, and operational performance.
•	Maintaining fleet records, operational documentation, maintenance histories, rental agreements, and preparing operational reports for management.
•	Coordinating relationships with external suppliers including repairers, maintenance providers, insurers, registration authorities, and transport contractors.
•	Ensuring compliance with workplace health and safety (WHS) legislation, road transport regulations, vehicle safety requirements, and company operational policies.
•	Developing and implementing procedures that improve fleet efficiency, customer satisfaction, operational performance, and cost control.
•	Supervising operational staff involved in fleet coordination and vehicle preparation while providing ongoing guidance and support.

Requirements
Australian Citizens and Permanent Residents are encouraged to apply.
Applicants should possess:
•	AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma in Business, Logistics, Automotive Management, Transport Management, Fleet Management, or a related discipline;
OR
•	At least three years of relevant work experience may substitute for formal qualifications.
Applicants should also demonstrate:
•	Experience managing vehicle fleets, rental operations, transport services, or automotive operations.
•	Strong knowledge of vehicle maintenance scheduling, fleet utilisation, and operational planning.
•	Excellent organisational and communication skills.
•	Strong customer service and stakeholder management capability.
•	Ability to prepare operational reports and maintain accurate fleet records.
•	Experience coordinating vehicle servicing, registrations, repairs, and compliance requirements.
•	Proficiency with Microsoft Office and fleet management software.
•	Knowledge of workplace health and safety legislation and vehicle compliance requirements.
•	Current Australian Driver Licence (preferred).

Work Conditions
•	Full-time, ongoing position.
•	Work location: 60–62 Captain Cook Drive, Caringbah NSW 2229.
•	Competitive salary of AUD $80,000 – $90,000 per annum plus superannuation.
•	Opportunity to work within one of Australia's leading vehicle rental businesses.
•	Professional working environment with ongoing career development opportunities.
Note: Preference will be given to suitably qualified Australian Citizens and Permanent Residents.
